result.note: Tested the first-ever BIMSTEC home ministers' meeting, the Delhi Declaration and its main commitments.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the meeting of BIMSTEC home ministers held in October 2026:
items: It was the first-ever meeting of BIMSTEC home ministers, and it adopted the Delhi Declaration.
The bloc condemned terrorism including cross-border terrorism and called for UN Security Council sanctions to be enforced.
Ministers pushed for early agreement on conventions covering extradition, transfer of sentenced prisoners and human trafficking.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three statements match the story. The home ministers adopted the Delhi Declaration on 13 October 2026, condemned terrorism in all its forms and also flagged crime groups that traffic people and force them to run online fraud from scam centres.
questions.source: Home ministers of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) adopted the Delhi Declaration on Tuesday at their first-ever meeting.
